title: Button cue list
description: What should be lit for each of the device's three buttons, as the hardware abstraction's Cues.set() takes it (cue model 1, Bollawax 0.2.x). A button is its number, 1 to 3. A valid list has at most one cue per button: a schema cannot say that, so a reader checks it as well and reports a second cue for a button at its "button" member, under the name one-per-button. The order of the list means nothing; a normaliser writes button order. A button with no cue is not driven. A reader that must not stop for a bad list (a light loop) normalises instead of refusing, and then keeps the last of two cues for one button. The bollardeck/1 wire names the buttons inner, middle and outer under the key "btn", and keeps those words for as long as it is bollardeck/1 (spec/bollardeck.md, 6.2; constants/constants.json, BUTTONS); that form is not this one, and bollardeck.device.cues.to_wire and from_wire translate between the two.

state.description: pulse breathes at 2 Hz; chase turns once a second.

role.description: What the light stands for; null when it stands for nothing.
